table.name: vtiger_mcp_token
table.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `vtiger_mcp_token` ( `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, `token_hash` CHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'SHA-256 hash of the Bearer token', `userid` INT NOT NULL COMMENT 'F-revo user ID (vtiger_users.id)', `label` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Human-readable label', `enabled` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1=active, 0=disabled', `created_at` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY `idx_token_hash` (`token_hash`), KEY `idx_userid` (`userid`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='MCP Bearer token to F-revo user mapping'
